request.objective:
The home-chain end of a LayerZero V2 bridge for the existing ERC-20 NIGHTSHIFT ($SHIFT) at 0xe5e58e53d0bb204aa62c995a6c8cc8a48e60c3ac on Ethereum (18 decimals, plain transfers, no fee): ShiftOFTAdapter, an OFT adapter that locks SHIFT on send and releases it on receive. LayerZero EndpointV2 on this chain: 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fE728c (endpoint id 30101). It will be paired with exactly one OFT on Robinhood Chain (endpoint id 30416), ordered separately. This is the only adapter (lockbox) for SHIFT, ever.

The owner and LayerZero delegate is 0x6c4c78f2c3bdf4c4318fe305fb1c8bc1694d19b5, set in the constructor. Only the owner can: setPeer (once per endpoint id), set the send and receive library config (DVNs and confirmations) through the endpoint as delegate, set enforced options, and lower the outbound rate limit. Use LayerZero V2 OApp/OFT semantics with 6 shared decimals and LayerZero's RateLimiter: at most 10,000,000 SHIFT may leave per destination per rolling hour; the owner can lower that limit, never raise it above 10,000,000 per hour. No fees, so nobody receives fees or payouts; no pause, no upgrade path, no rescue or sweep function: locked SHIFT can only leave as a release for a verified message.

Put the LayerZero code the contract needs under src/ and add nothing under lib/. The constructor must not revert when the endpoint and token addresses hold no code, because the launch verifier's protected-invariant harness deploys the contract in a fresh EVM. Nothing is called after deployment by the deployer: the owner wires it afterwards (setPeer to the Robinhood OFT, and a ULN config with 2 required DVNs, LayerZero Labs and one independent DVN, and 15 block confirmations, because LayerZero's default on Robinhood Chain is its dead DVN).

Foundry tests with LayerZero's test helpers: send locks exactly the sent amount minus dust, a verified receive releases it, only the peer is accepted, the rate limit blocks the 10,000,001st SHIFT in an hour and refills, only the owner can set peers, config and lower the limit, the limit can never be raised above the cap, and no function moves SHIFT out but a verified receive. Verify on Etherscan and Sourcify.
